versions.changelog:
- Initial release of 0bull-youtube-post skill.
- Allows publishing YouTube Shorts using real rented iPhones via the 0bull MCP server.
- Supports video submission through a public URL or direct upload.
- Requires a title (caption) for every Short; enforces YouTube’s 100-character limit.
- Tracks submission status with live polling through clearly defined status stages.
- Provides guidance for error handling and clarifies actions users should not perform.
